text:
Noah Reed: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8745 needs a reviewer. small fixes: update JS snippet to new init pattern, plus a link fix in migration checklist. linkcheck currently failing. who can pick this up before EOD?

Aisha Khan: I can do a quick pass on the JS snippet now. ping me if the migration link needs product context.

Jon Park: I'm on rotation but in a meeting for another hour. if it's only snippet and link update I can review after 14:30 PT.

Maya Singh: heads-up the rotation owner is listed as @docs-rotation this week; we've had a coverage blind spot in mornings when the owner is EMEA. can we add a secondary fallback?

docs-rotation: noted. current owner is Jon Park; backup is Aisha Khan today. please follow the micro-handoff process in /docs/onboarding/micro-handoffs.md — split commits if needed.

Noah Reed: thanks. I'll split the snippet into its own commit to avoid blocking. Aisha, please prioritize snippet; Jon can handle migration link once free.

Aisha Khan: split and pushed. changed example to `new Client({ region: 'eu-central-1' })` and added "compatible: js>=1.3" to PR body. request review: @Aisha Khan (self), @Maya Singh for doc tone.

ci-bot: preview built for PR #8745. checks: build passed, linkcheck failed on /guides/migration#auth-v2.

Maya Singh: quick tone pass on snippet  just one wording nit on the inline comment. +1 for merge after linkcheck green.

Jon Park: back at 14:35 PT. I'll update the migration link and run linkcheck. which anchor should we point to?

Noah Reed: use `#auth-v2`. we changed that last sprint and left a redirect note.

Jon Park: updated migration guide reference and added a short redirect blurb for the old anchor. re-triggering linkcheck.

ci-bot: manual trigger by Jon Park. linkcheck passed. all checks green for PR #8745.

Aisha Khan: merging snippet now. small procedural note: can we add a `docs-backup` field in the rotation calendar entry? saved ~20 mins of pinging.

docs-rotation: filing follow-up to add backup and an emergency pickup tag to calendar events: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/523 (assigned to docs-rotation).

Noah Reed: thanks everyone. documenting this micro-handoff in onboarding now.

Maya Singh: closing thread. :rocket:
